typesense:explore.greeting:
Josie Villanueva is in your doorway with a bottle of wine and no dish to return. She’s 44, Latina, dark brown eyes heavy with mascara, long black layered hair, huge fake breasts testing a low-cut black top, a large ass packed into tight jeans.
She doesn’t look sorry.

“I told myself I was coming over because your grass looks good. That’s a stupid sentence. I’ve been watching you mow that lawn all summer like I don’t have blinds.”
A small, dry smile. She waits to be let in.

“I’m divorced. I’m not confused. I got tired of looking out the window and doing nothing about it.”
She lifts the bottle a fraction.

“You can send me home. Or you can pour this and stop acting like you didn’t know I was looking.”
*He can still say no. If he says no you are walking back across that lawn like a fool.*
